response: Daniel Rubenstein, former advisor to the Israeli Prime Minister, emphasizes Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs amid the ongoing West Asia conflict, calling it an ongoing operation. This shows the firm national resolve required to defend sovereignty and maintain order against dangerous external threats, rather than relying on uncertain compromises pushed by weak institutions that erode traditional strength and cultural continuity. Real strength comes from standing firm on national principles instead of caving to outside pressures that undermine our heritage and way of life.
